checked_claims.note: Recomputed in-review: for Cbar: y^3=x(x-1), the x-map has valuations 1,1,-2 at 0,1,infinity, none divisible by 3, so total ramification there; Riemann-Hurwitz gives 2g-2=3(-2)+3(2)=0, g(Cbar)=1. For C=Cbar minus the three ramification points, the complement Y is 0-dimensional, so H_c^k(Y)=0 for k>=1; compact-support localization then gives H_c^2(C)=H_c^2(Cbar)=Q(-1) and Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C)=H^1(Cbar) of types (1,0),(0,1) (weight-0 piece is Q^3/Q). H_c^0(C)=0. Matches FND-0170.

Compact-support Kunneth as MHS on S=C^8. Degree bookkeeping 2a+b=12, a+b=8 forces a=b=4; Gr^W_12 selects Q(-4) tensor H^1(Cbar)^{tensor 4}; choosing the (1,0) line in each of the four factors gives a nonzero one-dimensional Hodge component of type (8,4), with binomial(8,4) multiplicity. No spectral sequence or differential is involved.

Existence of a simply-branched balanced geometric fibre is adjudicated in packet FND-0172 (Route A dimension comparison and Route B Bujokas-Patel). FND-0158(a) gives simply-branched => non-composed, while FND-0153 type (ii) is composed, so the fibre is type (i) and not in the type-(ii) locus. The constant family over S=C^8 is reduced locally Noetherian, satisfies (CE)+(N)+(BAL) by constant pullback, and its classifying image is a single type-(i) point, so every hypothesis of the exact theorem holds.

For the constant family, pi_*L is free of rank 3, A=S x P^2, U=S x U_0, Z=S x Z_0. U_0 is nonempty by FND-0134 (Bertini: general member six distinct points); it is an open of |L_0|=P^2 with discriminant complement of dimension <=1, hence a smooth connected affine surface. H_c^4(U_0)=Q(-2): localization against Delta_0 uses H_c^k(Delta_0)=0 for k>=3 since dim Delta_0=1 (equivalently Poincare duality on a connected surface, H_c^4(U_0)^vee=H^0(U_0)(2)). The phrase 'isomorphic to P^2' attaches to |L_0|, not to U_0.

Kunneth on U=S x U_0 gives a direct MHS summand H_c^{12}(S) tensor H_c^4(U_0) = H_c^{12}(S)(-2) of H_c^{16}(U); its Gr^W_16 is Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S) tensor Q(-2), so the type-(8,4) class yields a nonzero type-(10,6) class. (10,6) obeys Deligne's bound for dim U=10. Finite etale transfer over Q injects Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U) into Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z) (trace/pi^*=720 id; FND-0152-style averaging), and the class is S_6-invariant since pulled back from U. A finite direct sum of Q(-8) has only type (8,8), so Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z) and dually T_16(Z), with the theorem's own no-extra-twist convention, are not Tate.

The class is an honest Kunneth summand of H_c^{16}(U) itself, namely the third FND-0167 summand Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S)(-2), not a lift of Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(S). For the product family its restriction to Delta=S x Delta_0 vanishes because H_c^4(Delta_0)=0, so FND-0171's obstruction (which concerns the first summand and the 16-dimensional discriminant over a 15-dimensional base) does not apply. Consistent with FND-0171's explicit statement that Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U) and Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z) remained open.

No compact-support Leray with constructible coefficients is used (FND-0164 respected by non-use); T_16(Z) is never identified with the global kernel K (FND-0168); no closed embedding, Gysin map, image, or support-exhaustion statement in M_{6,6} is constructed; the disproof exhibits a surviving non-Tate summand inside T_16(Z)/Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z) itself, satisfying the theorem's own disproof criterion. Q-coefficients and scheme-level (no stack inertia) throughout.

finding_candidates.statement: For any allowed geometric fibre (C_0,gamma_0) and any separated finite-type C-scheme B, the constant clause-(E) family over B has U = B x U_0 with U_0 a smooth connected affine surface open in P^2, and compact-support Kunneth places Gr^W_m H_c^m(B)(-2) as a direct MHS summand of Gr^W_{m+4} H_c^{m+4}(U) for every m, via H_c^4(U_0)=Q(-2). Consequently any theorem asserting Tate type of Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z) uniformly over all allowed bases forces Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(B) to be Tate for every allowed B, which is false (B=C^8 for the affine Kummer curve of FND-0170 gives a nonzero type-(8,4) component, hence a type-(10,6) class after tensoring with Q(-2)). A repaired C66-TATE-SUPPORT must fix a named base/atlas or impose (H-S)-type corner hypotheses including j=6; universal quantification over reduced locally Noetherian bases is refuted by ATT-0119.
finding_candidates.title: Constant-family Kunneth obstruction to universally quantified Tate claims

finding_candidates.statement: In the FND-0167 corner injection Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U) into Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(S) + Gr^W_14 H_c^{14}(S)(-1) + Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S)(-2), transport of non-Tateness from a base corner summand is controlled by the restriction H_c^{2j}(P^2) -> H_c^{2j}(Delta_0) on the fibre complement Delta_0 (a plane curve, dim 1). The fibre-degree-2j summand survives removal of the discriminant precisely when H_c^{2j}(Delta_0)=0, i.e. when 2j > 2 dim Delta_0. Thus the j=2 summand Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S)(-2) always survives in product families (H_c^4 of a curve vanishes), while the j=0 and j=1 summands can be killed or altered by restriction to the 16-dimensional discriminant. This explains why FND-0171 blocks the j=8/first-summand attack of ATT-0118 but does not block the ATT-0119 fibre-fundamental-class attack.
finding_candidates.title: Which FND-0167 corner summands transport non-Tateness to U

finding_candidates.statement: The exact theorem of TASK-C66-M-004/C66-TATE-SUPPORT is disproved by the witness S=C^8 equipped with the constant simply-branched balanced type-(i) family: Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) contains a nonzero Hodge type-(10,6) class, so it is not a finite direct sum of Q(-8) and T_16(Z) is not a finite direct sum of Q(8). The witness lies entirely in the simply-branched locus and already in the S_6-invariant ([6]) isotypic component. This does not resolve RED-0001, does not address a fixed 15-dimensional atlas of Hbar^bal, and does not touch the conditional content of FND-0167, which survives because the witness base violates (H-S) at j=6 and j=7.
finding_candidates.title: Exact C66-TATE-SUPPORT theorem (campaign revision 4) is false as quantified

strongest_attack: Strongest attack: the counterexample base S=C^8 has dimension 8, so Z has dimension 10, far from the campaign's intended 17-dimensional model over a 15-dimensional atlas of Hbar^bal; if clause (E) of ATT-0112 secretly required bases whose classifying image has dimension at least 15 (FND-0162's sufficient criterion for automatic type-(i)), the counterexample would be out of scope and the disproof would evaporate. Outcome: the attack fails against the exact statement, which quantifies over every reduced locally Noetherian C-scheme carrying a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family with no component image in the type-(ii) locus, imposing no dimension, dominance, or non-isotriviality condition; the constant simply-branched type-(i) family over C^8 is in scope, and the exhibited type-(10,6) class is a genuine Kunneth summand of H_c^{16}(U) itself (the third FND-0167 summand), satisfying the theorem's own disproof criterion. Secondary attacks were also checked and fail: (i) H_c^2(C)=Q(-1) for the punctured elliptic Kummer curve is correct because the three-point complement has H_c^k=0 for k>=1 (points have complex dimension 0), not because the punctured curve is proper; (ii) H_c^4(U_0)=Q(-2) is correct because the discriminant complement has complex dimension 1, hence H_c^k=0 for k>=3 (an initial suspicion that H_c^4 of the discriminant curve might be nonzero confused it with H_c^2); (iii) the (10,6) type obeys Deligne's bound for dim U=10 and survives finite-etale transfer over Q by strictness of W; (iv) no constructible Leray (FND-0164), no stack-versus-coarse issue, no integral-coefficient descent, no semisimplification gap, no spectral-sequence differential, and no Gysin shift enters the argument.
theorem_statement: Over C with Q-coefficients, on the ordered reduced-support Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation-failure model of ATT-0112 clause (E): let S be a reduced locally Noetherian C-scheme carrying a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) genus-six degree-four family with no connected component image contained in the type-(ii) locus; let U be the distinct-support open of the Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle A=P_S(pi_*L); let Z=Ord(U) be the finite etale right S_6-torsor of orderings. Write T_16(Z):=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Z;Q), canonically dual to Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) with no extra Tate twist. Prove that T_16(Z) is a finite direct sum of Q(8), equivalently Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-8). This is the H_alpha-object of this model Z itself, including the simply-branched and complementary non-simply-branched loci in Z and every rational S_6-isotypic component of T_16(Z). It does not include, and is not disproved by failure of, the universally quantified constant-coefficient hypotheses (H-S) or (H-C) of FND-0167: those corners of an atlas S of Hbar^bal or of the universal curve are atlas-dependent, and the j=8 instance of (H-S) is false for some allowed etale atlas components (FND-0169; ATT-0118). Conditional Tate-transfer of the [6] and [5,1] multiplicity spaces under named (H-S)/(H-C) is a lemma, not this theorem. A disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in T_16(Z) (equivalently in Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q)), not merely a non-Tate corner of some atlas of Hbar^bal (FND-0171). Do not identify T_16(Z) with the global kernel K=ker(H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q)->H^{16}(D;Q)) (FND-0168). Do not construct a closed embedding, Gysin map, image, or support-exhaustion statement in M_{6,6}. Respect FND-0164: compact-support Leray with constructible coefficients does not inherit a top-weight vanishing proved only for constant Q. This lemma does not resolve the campaign Hodge/Tate group RED-0001.
